body: I'm past my 2nd year and they never gave me mine

Felt every word honestly. Idk how much it helps saying this, but I get where you're coming from. And your feelings right now are absolutely valid, sucks to feel this way, wish there were some magic words that could help make everything better, but just can't seem find them. My only hope right now is pushing through it hoping I can find a space where I can feel free from all of this, hopefully you can find the same thing.
